synopsis: An FMU packages a model to the open Functional Mock-up Interface (FMI) standard as a single file containing equations or compiled code and an input/output description [f13230, f13232]. FMI standardizes connections between simulation programs running together in step, while SSP records FMU wiring and parameters so the complete arrangement can be shared and reproduced [f13230, f13234]. Sensor models are delivered as FMUs using the Open Simulation Interface (OSI) message standard [f13235]. The tools-and-vendors chapter identifies Persival as offering credible sensor-model development and validation, including OSI FMUs and weather benches, connecting the glossary's packaging approach to a named supplier [f8812, f13235].

relations.note: Details FMI openness and the contents of an FMU package.
Adds parameter recording and reproducibility to SSP's description of FMU wiring.
Identifies sensor models as an FMU application using OSI messages.
Names a supplier offering OSI FMUs for sensor-model development and validation.
